content.title: March Madness scores: Buzzer-beater, epic upset and more nail-biters. Round 2 highlights
content.text: March 21, 2026Updated March 23, 2026, 7:37 a.m. ETSo much for all that chalk talk.On a weekend light on upsets, Iowa came to the Big Dance ready to boogie. Sunday night, the No. 9 Hawkeyes stunned defending national champion Florida with a 73-72 second round win.Alvaro Folgueras hit a corner 3-pointer in the corner with 2 seconds left to give the Hawkeyes a 73-72 lead. After a timeout, Florida was unable to get a shot attempt up, ending their hopes of a repeat.Even before Iowa's upset, Sunday's games have been great. The latest example: Sunday's game between No. 5 St. John's and No. 4 Kansas that came down to the buzzer. Dylan Darling's layup as time expired sent the Red Storm to its first Sweet 16 since 1999.Check out more of Sunday's results and who is headed to next week's Sweet 16:Stream March Madness on FuboWho is in Sweet 16?
